Rob Reiner posthumously wins Emmy for 'The Bear', sets record

Rob Reiner has posthumously won an Emmy Award for his work on the series 'The Bear'. This win breaks a 48-year-old record previously held by his father. The award ceremony included an emotional standing ovation for Reiner.
